claim_boundary: This artifact lists the minimum inputs required before a null/baseline fixture can move from hold to attempt-ready. It does not execute the fixture.

requirement_rows.required_content: exact preserved baseline equations, v13 reference state, or declared comparison target
specific switch such as Psi -> 0, scalar route disabled, coupling set to zero, or neutral spectator limit
list scalar contribution, candidate couplings, interaction placeholders, and any extension terms disabled for the fixture
list V(Psi), Z_Psi, EOM route, T_Psi_mu_nu, SI bridge, and conservation/divergence as held
state what should match the baseline: equation form, tensor/source terms, coefficients, or observables
declare whether fixture avoids these dependencies by full scalar disablement or needs derived artifacts
allowed labels: not_attempted, ready_to_attempt, blocked, fixture_design_only, observed_for_this_fixture_only
requirement_rows.not_allowed: recovered, passed, validated, or baseline proven

next_requirements: bind exact baseline equations or reference state
